scope: Fixed named subset only; no transitive closure/global UID/native acceptance or optical claim.
terminal_scope: Canonical API wait returned. Nonzero can be synthetic timeout/script-error; no separate OS child exit is exposed. A launch attempt flag alone does not prove a child started. Only canonical dev manages its own direct child.
diagnostic_qualification: Retained raw diagnostics are not classified as clean merely from zero exit. Review host/editor/script/audio/native messages separately.
